transformations: This original project-authored expected-only plan contains no profiler capture or observed value and therefore required no value replacement.

expectedObservations: Each component profile should prove its bundled or selected CUB/CCCL macros, acquisition hash, resolved include paths, exact build, and binary hash, with selected CCCL 3.4.2 limited to Toolkit 12.9.2 and 13.3.1.
EX11 and EX17 should independently pass the same exact 4099-float generator, double left-fold oracle, and absolute-plus-relative tolerance gate while retaining result bits and errors separately.

The DeviceReduce two-phase path should query and allocate temporary storage on the same current device with identical template arguments, workload, and process-local explicit stream before execution, while the returned capacity remains separate from every traffic claim.

Steady-state invocation timing and candidate-specific setup-inclusive timing should remain separate under the same device-selection and stream policy, workload, checked stream completion, std::chrono::steady_clock, and correctness cadence, with one candidate identity, one stream, one excluded local warm-up, and one measured call per timed process.

One profile-level excluded warm-up pair should precede ten retained pairs in the frozen odd EX11-to-EX17 and even EX17-to-EX11 order for every profile, while timing none executes only one candidate call.
Any failed subrecord should invalidate and preserve the whole batch, after which a new batch should rerun warm-up and all ten pairs without deleting or replacing a sample.

EX11's 16472-byte source-derived logical global ledger should remain separate from distinct exact-GPU custom and CUB profiler observations, and no CUB traffic should be inferred from temporary-storage bytes.
Every logical DeviceReduce call should map to the actual zero, one, or multiple reported kernel launches rather than a predeclared one-kernel assumption.
A qualifying batch should report count=10, median, minimum, and maximum separately for each candidate, profile, timing family, and valid exact field scope, with no actual value prefilled here.
The maintenance packet should cover owned source, tests, component pins and upgrades, compatibility, and incident/debug burden without naming a winner; VIS10 should remain evidence-neutral.
